title: TRAFIQ Camera Registry
description: Defines monitored areas with geographic coordinates and livestream URLs.

id.description: Unique camera identifier (e.g. 'cam5'). Used in incident logs and socket events.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the UI.

area.description: Geographic area or intersection name for map grouping.

stream_url.description: RTSP, HLS, or local file path for the AI-engine video source.

media_url.description: URL shown in the frontend preview (e.g. Windy iframe embed, or /videos/... for local files).

media_type.description: 'video' for <video> tag sources, 'iframe' for embedded players.

city.description: Display city/region label for UI grouping (e.g. 'Astrakhan, Russia 🇷🇺').

enabled.description: Set to false to skip this camera without removing the entry.
